points.description: States that in a flat region (no edge/corner) there is no change in intensity in any direction when the detector window is shifted.
States that on an edge there is no (significant) change in intensity along the edge direction (change only perpendicular to it).
States that at a corner there is significant change in intensity in all directions when the window is shifted.
States that the Harris detector's response depends on direction of shift (intensity change is direction dependent), so edge direction distinguishes flat, edge and corner regions.

rubric.notes: Each point needs a precise statement about intensity change on shifting the window, tied to the correct region (flat, edge, corner). Vague statements such as 'direction matters' without the region-specific behaviour earn nothing. A wrong region-behaviour pairing (e.g. edge changes in all directions) loses that point. Total of marks is 2; half-marks per point, no partial within a point.
